user_feedback.scope: Positive feedback on V5; does not approve a new ten-minute schedule, audio or a 4K/full-length export.

request: Save all details needed for the longer version, then commit and push.

clock_design.do_not_change_scene_duration: Keep Scene.duration=60; changing it before construction also changes existing cloud renewal and plume transport. Add a separate attention_cycle_seconds=600.
clock_design.chunk_rendering: Carry absolute scene time into every chunk. Do not reset attention events at minute or chunk boundaries.

attention_events.status: Explicit deterministic draft; preserve V5 event shapes/gains/routes while changing event clock and onset only. Render/listen review may alter onsets. All attention layers quiet across the 600s join.

implementation.preserve_v5: Copy/freeze the V5 renderer, settings, dependencies and delivery fingerprint; do not edit the backed-up V5 candidate.
suggested_method: Subclass the frozen V5 Scene. Set self.absolute_scene_seconds before calling super().frame(absolute_scene_seconds % 60).
Override lamp_amount to use the proposed 600s clusters and the original source event shapes/depths. Do not retain the automatic minute lamp events.
Override glare_amount to use the 600s glint onsets, then apply the unchanged shadow attenuation at weather_phase.

Replace only the traffic event list with the 600s onset list and original V5 colour/duration/direction variants. Override vehicle_state: test global age modulo600 first; if active, pass source_event.time+active_age to the frozen V5 vehicle_state so its local 25s route and depth remain unchanged. Return None outside that passage.

Keep masks, source geometry, source-space speeds, white beacon core/halo and daylight exposure exact. Keep the original small village walkers on their V3 minute timing unless review identifies that repeat as distracting.
Add an isolated attention-layer render and a full ten-minute 720p timing audition. This plan alone does not implement a long renderer.

audio.status: No Crater Rim soundtrack or SFX mix supplied/approved in current records.
audio.perspective: Warm enclosed survey room; exterior basin air behind glass.
proposed_sfx: Quiet indoor ventilation/room air, separately controllable.
Intermittent distant exterior basin wind, shaped to visible haze activity and auditioned in context.
avoid_automatic_additions: No automatic Hoth radio/creak/snow settings transfer.
Distant rovers, footsteps and mast beacons need not be audible through the closed room.
No rain/thunder or paid generation is authorized by this continuation plan.
audio.mix_gate: Save actual source exports, prompts/settings and hashes; choose joins by listening, level-match tests, approve the full timing/mix and record gains before long assembly.

production.source_detail_note: Lanczos upscale native1672x941; never enlarge the encoded720p preview into production4K.
production.encoding: H.264 QP0, YUV420p, explicit BT.709 primaries/transfer/matrix and TV range, matching source conversion.
production.clean_master: Silent600s master or ten contiguous60s production chunks with absolute timing; no opening baked into a repeated unit.
production.opening: Use the hash-verified current Colony export engine/intro once: graphics clear by22s; audio silence to5s/fade to20s. Check actual engine release before assembly.
production.closing: Single requested closing fade, following the accepted soundtrack recipe; avoid repeated opening/closing fades within the cycle.
production.assembly: Stream-copy accepted clean visual units for the confirmed runtime, with the opening rendered once. Verify final duration/timestamps, repeated pictures and full audio envelope.
production.storage: Long4K masters, repeated exports and caches under ignored exports/14-crater-rim-survey/ or per-run .local; do not add long combined files to Git.

validation: Verify every backed-up V5 input SHA-256 before work.
At same weather phase compare all seven retained layers to V5; compare a fired long event to the corresponding V5 event local age, preserving shapes/gains.
Check quiet event states and source protection throughout; preserve non-folding safe sky taps and full emitter/fixture coverage.
Decode all18000frames/timestamps for a600s30fps master; check every event start/peak/end and every chunk boundary with direct native-to-YUV controls.
Compare last-to-first changes with ordinary neighbors for each layer and decoded composite; inspect a short continuous join review without duplicating a large master unnecessarily.
Review ten minutes at normal size/speed; look for distracting lamp, obvious vehicle repeats, soft/doubled cloud renewal or intrusive glints. Technical gates are not artistic approval.
After4K delivery, assemble with confirmed audio/runtime and verify complete final video/audio decode and soundtrack envelope.
